editorial.blurb: Southern Chicago brings warm hospitality and well-crafted American comfort food to the south loop, with standout sides and thoughtful drinks that keep guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the bar for a smoother experience, order the buttermilk biscuits and sides family-style to share, and ask your server for menu details—Rich and Messler know their stuff.

topDishes.note: Reviewers call them "slammin'" and absolutely spectacular
Very good, though expectations vary—a beloved side dish
